Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier. 现在我已掌握所有关键信息，下面给出完整分析。

---

## 1. 本季度收入同比增长百分比

**原始数据：**
- **Q4 FY26（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026）**：Intelligent Cloud 收入 = **$39,306 百万**
- **Q4 FY25（Three Months Ended June 30, 2025）**：Intelligent Cloud 收入 = **$29,878 百万**

出处：`financial_statements.txt` 位置 8877（分部利润表）和 19278（历史季度数据）。

**计算过程：**

```
同比增长率 = (39,306 - 29,878) / 29,878 × 100
           = 9,428 / 29,878 × 100
           = 31.56%
```

管理层在新闻稿和电话会中报告的口径为 **32%**（按报告口径 GAAP），按固定汇率调整后为 **31%**。`press_release.txt` 位置 3115 明确写道：

> "Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"

32% 是将 31.56% 四舍五入到整数后的结果。

---

## 2. 管理层在财报电话会上的归因（原文引用）

来源：`transcript.txt` 位置 **25121–25178**（FY26 Q4 业绩回顾 · Intelligent Cloud 部分），完整引用如下：

> **归因① — 需求强劲**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.**"

> **归因② — CPU/GPU 效率提升**
> "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet**"

> **归因③ — 流程改进带来更早产能交付**
> "as well as **process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity**"

> **归因④ — 新增产能被快速变现**
> "**That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.**"

> **归因⑤ — GitHub Copilot 消费超预期**
> "Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

> **归因⑥ — 本地服务器续约时点集中确认收入**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations **primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

此外，对整个分部毛利率下降的解释中也提到了：
> "gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year **primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand**, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."

> "Segment gross margins were also impacted by **growing GitHub Copilot usage**, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing."

---

## 3. 归因中事实 vs 前瞻性表述的区分

我逐条判断如下：

| # | 归因因素 | 性质 | 判断依据 |
|---|---------|------|---------|
| ① | "Customer demand **continues to** exceed available capacity" | **事实** | "continues" 描述的是 Q4 期间持续存在的**当前状态**。虽然"持续"一词隐含延续性，但它是对 Q4 期间可观察现象的陈述（需求数据已发生），并非对未来的推测。|
| ② | "efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **事实** | "gains"（已实现的效率提升）是**已完成**的动作的结果，且紧接着的 "Revenue growth **was** ahead of expectations" 使用了过去时，明确指向已发生的结果。|
| ③ | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" | **事实** | "improvements"（已完成的流程改进）和 "was quickly monetized" 均指向**已实施并已产生效果**的事件。|
| ④ | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure **was** quickly monetized" | **事实** | 明确的过去时态，描述 Q4 内已发生的事件。|
| ⑤ | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **事实** | "consumption"（消费行为）是 Q4 期间已发生的实际数据；"following the June business model change" 指 6 月已生效的商业模式变更。|
| ⑥ | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **事实** | 描述合同组合导致的收入确认时点变化，是**已发生**的会计事项的结果。|
| ⑦ | "the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand"（毛利率部分） | **边界情况 — 主要为事实，带前瞻色彩** | "continued scaling" 描述 Q4 期间正在进行的投资扩张（已发生的事实），但 "ahead of growing demand" 中 "growing" 描述的是需求趋势（已观察到的趋势），整体是对当前正在进行的战略动作的描述，而非对未来的预测。|

**结论：在上述所有列出的归因因素中，没有一条是严格意义上的前瞻性表述（如"我们期望""预计""展望"等措辞）。所有因素都是对 Q4 FY26 期间已发生事实的解释。**

**区分依据：**
- **事实**：使用过去时态（"was", "grew", "were"）、描述已完成的动作用语（"gains", "improvements", "was monetized"），或描述 Q4 当期持续可观察现象的现在进行时（"continues to exceed"）。
- **前瞻性表述**：典型特征为将来时态、意图/期望类动词（"expect", "anticipate", "remain focused on delivering", "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"），出现在 transcript 的 `position 33049` 展望段落中，但**不属于**对 Q4 增长本身的归因。

简言之，管理层对 Q4 IC 增长 32% 的所有归因，全部是基于已发生事实的解释，未包含对未来走势的判断。
